w10_T4_004396: A craft shop has 5 spools of ribbon with 159 yards on each spool. A supplier sends 22 more yards of ribbon. The ribbon comes in 14 colours. Since every yard is 3 feet, the shop lists its ribbon in feet, and it has already used 685 feet of it on gift baskets. The rest is sold at 5 cents per foot, and a customer who buys all of it also pays 45 cents for a bag. How many cents does that customer pay?
w10_T4_004398: Gina packed 65 crates with 8 oranges in each crate for the market. The oranges were shared equally among 5 stalls, and Hal ran one of the stalls. Hal sold 61 oranges before lunch, then took delivery of 28 more from a farm cart, 57 more from Gina's van, and 51 more from a neighbouring grower. By closing time Gina's own stall had sold out, so Hal had more oranges left than Gina. How many oranges did Hal have at closing time?
w10_T4_004400: Sofia started the arcade game with 90 points and picked up 38 more points on the first level. A bonus mushroom then doubled her score. On the next level every point she had was worth 6 points, and on the final level every point she had was then worth 9 points. How many points did Sofia finish the game with?
w10_T4_004404: Grandma's cookie tin was packed with 4 layers of 22 cookies each. Over the weekend the grandchildren ate 26 cookies. Grandma then gave 15 cookies to a neighbour who was feeling unwell. On Monday she baked 64 fresh cookies and put them all in the tin. How many cookies were in the tin after that?
w10_T4_004410: In the morning Cara's farm stall had 240 strawberries, all from a single crate, and she added 37 more that she picked before opening. In the afternoon she sold 103 strawberries and threw out 28 that had gone soft. In the evening her brother Dan counted his own stall and found he had 9 times as many strawberries as Cara. Dan then picked 56 more strawberries before closing. How many strawberries did Dan have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004411: Maya's memory card held 202 photos from her trip. She deleted 172 blurry ones and then took 3 more of the sunset. At the print shop she ordered 9 prints of every photo left on the card. She added 65 prints from an older trip to the same album box, and later threw away 11 prints that were creased. How many prints were in the album box?
w10_T4_004418: In the morning a decorator started with a 201-yard roll of bunting, but 71 yards were torn and thrown away. In the afternoon she found that each of the 9 streets in the festival needed exactly that much bunting, and that the organisers wanted 9 complete sets so that every street could be re-hung on each day of the festival. In the evening she placed the order with a supplier who sells by the foot, and since a yard is 3 feet, she converted her total into feet. How many feet of bunting did she order?
w10_T4_004419: In the morning each of the 122 cows on a dairy farm gave 7 pints of milk. In the afternoon the farmer tallied that the whole day's milking came to 5 times the morning amount. There are 5 farms in the co-op, each produced exactly the same amount that day, and the co-op kept up that daily total for 9 days in a row. In the evening of the last day the bottler asked for the total in cups, and since each pint is 2 cups, the manager converted it. How many cups of milk did the co-op produce over the 9 days?
w10_T4_004422: Jun scored 193 points in the opening round of the tournament, more than his teammate Kim. A power-up then tripled his score. In the second round every point he held was worth 6 points, in the third round every point was worth 5 points, and in the fourth round every point was worth 5 points again. The tournament rule is that a player's final score is shared equally among the 6 members of his team. How many points did Jun receive from his own final score?
w10_T4_004424: Rosa bought 74 tulip bulbs, then went back to the garden centre and bought the same again, so that she had double the bulbs. The flower bed is 4 metres long. When she opened the bags she found 5 bulbs had rotted and threw them out. Every bulb she planted sent up 3 blooms, and she sold every bloom for 6 cents each. How many cents did Rosa make from the blooms?
w10_T4_004425: Leo's parents set his weekly screen-time limit as a number of hours, but Leo converted it into minutes so he could keep track, and it came to 204 minutes. On Monday morning he used 23 minutes. In the afternoon he used 56 minutes on a video call and 7 minutes checking the weather. In the evening he watched a 36-minute show. How many minutes of screen time did Leo have left?
w10_T4_004440: Ivy had 78 stickers in her album. Her classmate Jake gave her 13 of his, which meant Ivy now had more stickers than Jake. Ivy then gave 51 stickers to a couple of her cousins, lost 20 when her bag got wet, and traded 14 away at school. Finally 1 sticker tore and had to be thrown out. How many stickers did Ivy have left?
w10_T4_004445: At the Monday morning meeting the site manager noted that the bridge project was scheduled for 138 weeks and that 131 weeks had already passed. She keeps her chart in days, and since each week is 7 days, she rewrote the remaining time in days. The crew has 15 workers. In the afternoon the client agreed to cut 8 days from the schedule, and the manager also marked off 39 days of work that a subcontractor would now handle. In the evening she found that 1 more day could be trimmed. How many days of work were left on the manager's chart?
w10_T4_004448: Mo kept 229 beads in his craft jar. He added 19 beads from a broken necklace and 53 beads from a new packet. His friend Nia had 8 times as many beads as Mo. Nia then bought 69 more beads at the craft fair. How many beads did Nia have?
w10_T4_004452: A farm's water tank holds 224 gallons. The tank is 2 metres tall. The farmer measures water in pints, and since a gallon is 8 pints, he wrote down the tank's contents in pints. He drew off 1285 pints for the cattle, then a rain shower added 73 pints. He drew off another 479 pints for the vegetable beds, and a leaking pipe dripped 3 pints back into the tank. How many pints of water were in the tank?
w10_T4_004454: Ollie has 47 nickels in his piggy bank. His sister Pia has twice as many nickels as Ollie. Since a nickel is worth 5 cents, Pia worked out the value of her nickels in cents. She then added 42 cents in pennies to her savings and spent 134 cents on a comic. How many cents does Pia have left?
w10_T4_004457: Bea's jar held 102 nickels. Her aunt dropped in 70 more nickels and her uncle added 10. The jar is 20 centimetres tall. Since a nickel is 5 cents, Bea counted her savings in cents, and then found 18 cents in loose pennies to add. Over the next 5 weeks she saved exactly that same amount every week. How many cents did Bea save over those 5 weeks?
w10_T4_004466: In the morning a print shop ran off 51 sheets with 8 stickers on each sheet for a school. In the afternoon an assistant added 67 leftover stickers from an earlier job and 24 stickers that had been returned. In the evening the school asked for 9 times that quantity, because the order was for 4 branches of the school and had to be repeated for 4 weeks of the term. How many stickers did the print shop have to supply in all?
w10_T4_004467: A warehouse had 154 crates of jam. A truck delivered 48 more crates, and a couple of forklifts moved 84 crates out for shipping. The warehouse has 3 loading docks. Each crate holds 8 boxes, and each box holds 4 jars. There were also 62 loose jars on a shelf. How many jars of jam were in the warehouse?
w10_T4_004475: Ken picked 203 cherries from the tree in his garden and his mother picked 48 more. The cherry tree is 30 years old. They threw out 2 cherries that were bruised and gave 147 cherries to the neighbours. The rest were shared equally among 6 cousins, including Lia. Lia ate 16 of hers straight away, while Ken kept his own share untouched, so Ken had more left than Lia. How many cherries did Lia have left?
w10_T4_004478: In the morning Zed had 57 dollars in his wallet. He spent 16 dollars on breakfast, then was paid 78 dollars for a morning of yard work. In the afternoon he spent 64 dollars on new shoes. In the evening he found 8 dollars in an old coat pocket, and his friend Yara, who had less money than Zed, paid him back the 6 dollars she owed him. How many dollars did Zed have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_004479: Amir's daily walk follows a 225-yard loop through the park, which was lengthened by 6 yards when a new bench was put in. Each morning he walks the loop 3 times. His fitness app measures in feet, and since a yard is 3 feet, it converts his loop total into feet. On top of that the app counted 75 feet from the car park to the trail, 34 feet around the bench, and 78 feet back to the car. How many feet did the app record for his morning walk?
w10_T4_004481: A corner shop had 138 cans of juice on the shelf. The owner stacks juice in six-packs, and since a six-pack holds 6 cans, she counted the stock in six-packs. A dozen customers came in on Saturday morning. She sold 6 six-packs, then took delivery of 51 six-packs and later another 35. In the run-up to the holiday she sold 88 six-packs. How many six-packs of juice were left?
w10_T4_004482: Ivan signed up for a 47-week training programme. Since each week has 7 days, he counted the programme in days, and then the coach added 47 extra days to it. His friend Jana's programme was 7 times as many days as Ivan's. Jana has already completed 860 days of hers. How many days does Jana have left?
w10_T4_004485: A hotel ordered 74 square yards of carpet, then cancelled 32 square yards of the order. Since a square yard is 9 square feet, the supplier wrote the order up in square feet, and the hotel then added an 80-square-foot runner for the stairs. The client phoned a couple of times to confirm. The hotel wants the identical carpet on each of its 9 floors. How many square feet of carpet does the supplier need to deliver?
